task: Separate immutable parent completion authority from the final-main development-plan envelope by deriving a state-bound parent closure proof-plan for the accepted final main.

operationalIntelligence.problemStatement: Release Unit Execution #287 proves trusted parent main reconciliation now passes, but runParentProof still loads the immutable source active-plan and reuses it as the development-plan envelope against the newer accepted final main. That conflates immutable parent completion authority with the current closure transaction and causes independently planned/verified hardening files to fail as DEV_PLAN_UNPLANNED_FILE plus domain/authority/subsystem scope expansion. The source rehearsal plan must remain immutable and authoritative for parent requirements; historical hardening must not be retroactively added to it. Parent proof therefore needs a deterministic executor-derived closure proof-plan bound to the source plan digest, canonical CLOSED-unit receipts, trusted-main proof and exact final main. The derived plan scopes only the closure metadata transaction while carrying the original parent task identity and completion contract.
observableOutcomes: runParentProof loads and validates the immutable source plan but does not use that historical implementation envelope directly for final-main Plan Before Code/Edit-Time.
A deterministic parent closure proof-plan is derived from immutable source plan + canonical parent state + exact final main + trusted-main proof.
The derived plan keeps taskId equal to parentTransactionId and copies the immutable source completionContract byte-equivalent.
The derived plan sets changeBaseSha to the accepted exact final main and scopes planned material only to quality/development/active-plan.json as the closure metadata transaction.

The derived plan removes historical mustEdit/mustCreate obligations from semanticExecutionRoute and replaces them with closure-only route metadata; historical implementation remains proven by child close receipts and trusted-main evidence.
The derived plan carries a machine-bound parentClosureContext with sourceCommit, sourcePlanDigest, finalMainSha, ordered unit close receipt digests and trustedMainAdvanceDigest.
recordReleaseParentClosure rejects lifecycle/truth produced from a missing, forged, stale or mismatched parentClosureContext.
Full Knowledge/Plan/Edit-Time/Incremental/Risk/Customer/Market/Quality/TypeScript/Build/Verification/Truth/Lifecycle still run on the exact accepted final main.

Closure PR persists the emitted CLOSED derived plan, so PR-head CI verifies only the metadata closure diff against the accepted final main rather than replaying historical hardening as new implementation.

If main safely advances while closure PR is pending, the existing persistence reprojection derives a fresh closure proof-plan bound to the new final main and requires fresh exact-head proof before merge.
Immutable source branch and canonical persisted release-state remain untouched except through the existing executor.
The canonical release-unit-orchestrate PARENT_CLOSE event path requires the same derived parentClosureContext authority and rejects legacy context-free close events.
unresolvedRisks: A derived plan that simply expands plannedFilePatterns from actual diff would be circular and could bless unplanned history.
A derived plan that drops the immutable completionContract would lose the original parent requirements.
A derived plan with stale unit receipt digests could certify a different parent state.
A derived plan that reuses trustedMainAdvanceDigest from an older final main could detach Truth from repository identity.
A closure plan with historical mustCreate/mustEdit obligations would recreate Edit-Time false blockers.
A closure plan whose changeBaseSha is not the accepted final main could again re-plan historical commits.
PR-head CI must treat the derived closed plan as metadata-only closure, not as permission to change runtime files.
Source plan lifecycle/status must not be rewritten or persisted.
Leaving scripts/release-unit-orchestrate.mjs on legacy context-free PARENT_CLOSE semantics would create a bypass around the strict parent closure proof path.

in: Bind the derived closure plan to immutable source plan digest, source commit, parent transaction id, exact final main, ordered unit close receipt digests and trusted-main proof digest.
Use the derived plan as SHOPERATION_ACTIVE_PLAN during parent final-main proof.
Preserve the immutable source completionContract exactly in the derived plan.
Set derived changeBaseSha to exact finalMain and scope the derived development transaction to quality/development/active-plan.json only.
Validate derived context again before recordReleaseParentClosure accepts parent Truth/Lifecycle.
Regress no-main-advance, trusted-main-advance and PR_OPEN reprojection paths.
Keep parent closure CI dispatch and force-with-lease persistence semantics unchanged.

Update release-unit-orchestrate.mjs so PARENT_CLOSE forwards and requires sourceCommit/sourcePlanDigest/completionContractDigest/closureProofPlanDigest/parentClosureProofContext fields expected by strict parent closure recording.
out: No mutation or widening of immutable source plan.
No generic plan bypass or ignored DEV_PLAN_UNPLANNED_FILE.
No change to child close receipts or U01/U02/U03 material.
No change to trusted-main fast-forward/protected-output checks.
No workflow, storefront, Builder, database or deployment change.

assuranceCeiling.rationale: This plan becomes the development-plan authority used by final parent Truth/Lifecycle. It must remain fully derived from already-authoritative immutable inputs and may not become a mechanism for retroactive scope widening.

acceptanceCriteria: Derived contract id is explicit and versioned.
Derived completionContract deep-equals immutable source completionContract.
Derived changeBaseSha equals exact accepted finalMain.
Derived semantic route contains no historical mustEdit/mustCreate implementation obligations.
Derived expected domain/authority remain bounded to closure metadata authority and pass canonical Plan Before Code.
sourcePlanDigest is computed from the immutable source plan exactly as read from sourceCommit.
unitCloseReceiptDigests equal the ordered current canonical CLOSED-unit receipts.
trustedMainAdvanceDigest is exact when a trusted advance exists and null when finalMain equals last child main.
recordReleaseParentClosure rejects any closure proof-plan context mismatch before setting closureComplete.
Parent final-main proof passes Plan/Edit-Time on the derived closure transaction while still running full runtime quality gates on finalMain.
Emitted closed lifecycle plan retains parentClosureContext and verifiedImplementationHead=finalMain.
Closure PR exact-head CI passes against the derived closed plan.
Immutable rehearsal replay advances beyond the #287 DEV_PLAN_UNPLANNED_FILE blocker.
A PARENT_CLOSE orchestration event without the derived closure context fields fails closed; an exact derived context event reaches the strict parent closure primitive.
invariants: Immutable source plan remains the sole parent completion-requirement authority.
Historical implementation scope is proven by child/evolution receipts, not retroactively replanned.
Derived plan is a closure transaction, not a replacement source plan.
Exact final main and canonical state identity are embedded in the derived plan.
Truth/Lifecycle cannot be accepted from a derived plan built for another state or SHA.
No fail-closed gate is disabled or skipped.
All canonical parent-close entry points enforce the same closure context authority.

failureModes: Source plan taskId differs from canonical parentTransactionId.
Source plan completionContract is missing or has external guard obligations not available to parent proof.
Derived context finalMainSha differs from finalMain being proven.
Unit close receipts change after derived plan construction.
Trusted-main proof changes or disappears after derived plan construction.
Plan Before Code projects a scope broader than closure metadata.
Edit-Time sees historical semantic mustEdit obligations because route sanitation is incomplete.
Truth or lifecycle emitter strips parentClosureContext.
Closure PR is based on a different main than the derived plan changeBaseSha.
Main advances while PR is pending and stale derived plan is reused.
release-unit-orchestrate accepts a context-free PARENT_CLOSE event after strict parent closure enforcement exists elsewhere.
edgeCases: No trusted main advance: finalMain equals last child merge and trustedMainAdvanceDigest is null.
One or more trusted main advances already occurred before parent proof.
Second safe main advance occurs during PR_OPEN and requires a new derived closure plan.
Source plan contains original mustCreate fixture corpus.
Current main active-plan belongs to unrelated hardening and must not become parent completion authority.
Derived plan status transitions ready-for-implementation -> closed with only active-plan metadata diff.
Derived closed plan PR CI evaluates changedSinceVerified containing only active-plan metadata.

alternatives.summary: Keep source completion authority immutable and derive a bound closure-only development plan for final-main proof.
alternatives.reason: Separates historical intent from closure transaction while preserving all fail-closed proof identities.

alternatives.summary: Append every later hardening file/domain/authority into the original rehearsal source plan.
alternatives.reason: Retroactively changes immutable intent and makes planning circular.

alternatives.summary: Use whichever hardening plan happens to be active on current main as parent proof authority.
alternatives.reason: Its taskId/completionContract describe a different transaction and would lose parent rehearsal requirements.

alternatives.summary: Run only tests/build/truth during parent proof.
alternatives.reason: Violates the accepted full gate chain and hides closure transaction mistakes.

specialistReviews.finding: One active-plan object cannot safely represent both immutable historical parent intent and a later metadata-only closure transaction.
specialistReviews.resolution: Introduce an explicit derived closure-plan contract that copies completion requirements but replaces only transaction-envelope fields.

specialistReviews.finding: A generated plan could become a scope-bypass if it is derived from observed changed files.
specialistReviews.resolution: Derive scope from fixed closure semantics only and bind context to immutable source digest + canonical receipts + exact final main.

specialistReviews.finding: Truth must identify the same parent state that the closure receipt later records.
specialistReviews.resolution: Validate ordered unit close receipt digests and trusted-main proof digest both during derivation and recordReleaseParentClosure.

specialistReviews.finding: PR_OPEN reprojection must derive a fresh plan on each new accepted finalMain.
specialistReviews.resolution: runParentProof derives the closure plan on every call and never reuses one from an older main.

specialistReviews.finding: The exact #287 failure is deterministic: historical source plan envelope rejects later verified hardening files.
specialistReviews.resolution: Keep the failure recorded in #1129 and require immutable replay to pass beyond these exact DEV_PLAN_* blockers.

challenge.scenario: Copy source plan and only set changeBaseSha=finalMain.
challenge.finding: Historical mustEdit/mustCreate route remains and Edit-Time blocks.
challenge.resolution: Replace semantic route with closure-only metadata route.

challenge.scenario: Union historical hardening files into plannedFilePatterns.
challenge.resolution: Derived plannedFilePatterns is fixed to active-plan metadata only.

challenge.scenario: Use current main's active hardening plan.
challenge.finding: taskId and completionContract no longer represent the parent rehearsal.
challenge.resolution: Copy immutable source taskId/completionContract into derived closure plan.

challenge.scenario: Derived plan is generated for currentMain but unit receipts change before closure acceptance.
challenge.finding: Truth could close a different parent state.
challenge.resolution: Bind and revalidate ordered unit receipt digests in parentClosureContext.

challenge.scenario: Trusted-main proof is replaced after plan derivation.
challenge.finding: Closure context could detach from accepted main evolution.
challenge.resolution: Bind exact trustedMainAdvanceDigest and revalidate before parent close receipt.

challenge.finding: Requiring a proof digest would incorrectly block exact last-child main closure.
challenge.resolution: Explicit null digest is canonical when finalMain equals last child main.

challenge.scenario: Lifecycle emitter drops custom closure context.
challenge.finding: recordReleaseParentClosure cannot prove lifecycle came from the derived plan.
challenge.resolution: Regression-test context preservation through buildClosedDevelopmentPlan/closed plan emission.

challenge.scenario: Closure PR CI sees the derived closed plan with verifiedImplementationHead=finalMain and one metadata file changed.
challenge.finding: If closed-plan semantics reject this metadata closure the design still deadlocks.
challenge.resolution: Add end-to-end regression/source assertion for closed-plan metadata-only PR proof.

challenge.finding: Old derived plan changeBaseSha/finalMain becomes stale.
challenge.resolution: Persistence reprojection reruns runParentProof, deriving a fresh context and plan for new main.

challenge.scenario: Parent proof passes runtime tests but derived plan completionContract was modified.
challenge.resolution: Builder deep-copies source completionContract and validator compares its strong digest to source.

challenge.scenario: An operator invokes scripts/release-unit-orchestrate.mjs with a legacy PARENT_CLOSE event containing only truth/lifecycle/currentMainSha.
challenge.finding: If accepted, this bypasses source-plan/state/final-main context binding even though release-unit-parent-close.mjs is strict.
challenge.resolution: Route PARENT_CLOSE through the strict parent closure record path and require all derived context bindings in the event.

Modify runParentProof to read immutable source plan, derive closure plan, persist only that artifact as SHOPERATION_ACTIVE_PLAN, and keep the source plan itself untouched.

Require exact-head Quality/TypeScript/Build/Completion Truth/Lifecycle PASS, then PR-head PASS and expected-head merge.

After expected-head merge, require the exact merged main SHA to complete push CI with Quality Tests, TypeScript and Production Build all SUCCESS before any immutable rehearsal replay is started; any non-success keeps the parent closure repair unaccepted.
Replay immutable source SHA 65e52ffd1fd32f14353467eb7c52b2e06ba1be65 and require Release Unit Execution to advance beyond #287's DEV_PLAN_UNPLANNED_FILE/domain/authority/subsystem blockers.
If a different downstream blocker appears, keep it fail-closed and route it through Failure Intake instead of widening the derived plan.

requirements.requirement: Parent final-main proof must keep immutable source completion authority while using a deterministic state-bound closure-only development plan for the final metadata transaction.

forbiddenRegressions.statement: Parent closure may not mutate or retroactively widen the immutable source plan.
Parent Truth/Lifecycle may not close without exact source-plan/state/final-main context binding.
Historical trusted hardening may not be reinterpreted as new unplanned implementation during parent closure.
The derived closure plan may not weaken or alter the immutable source completionContract.
Canonical release-unit-orchestrate PARENT_CLOSE may not bypass derived closure context validation.

notes: Live blocker: main e296c5203b115737cd5b375275ab2ef8d725974c; immutable source 65e52ffd1fd32f14353467eb7c52b2e06ba1be65; source CI #8928 attempt 15 SUCCESS; Release Unit Execution #287 FAIL. Trusted-main reconciliation passes, but runParentProof reuses the immutable source development-plan envelope against newer final main and fails with DEV_PLAN_UNPLANNED_FILE plus DOMAIN/AUTHORITY/SUBSYSTEM scope expansion for independently planned/verified Control Plane hardening. Issue #1129 updated with this exact downstream blocker. This transaction does not widen the source plan; it introduces a deterministic closure-only proof plan bound to source completion authority, canonical receipts and exact final main. Pre-implementation route audit found scripts/release-unit-orchestrate.mjs still exposes canonical context-free PARENT_CLOSE; scope is expanded before code so every parent-close entry point enforces the same derived closure authority.
